'''Anakin Jedi Knight Lightsaber Combat Gets me Credits''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Anakin Jedi Knight]]
* '''Published:''' 21 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone|Cor-L-thehyperdrivegeneratorsgone.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone Knig.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

THGG deck designed to foil DS Lightsaber Combat.

== Strategy ==

The Strategy of this deck is to win the podrace.  You use Lando, Panaka, JarJar and Obiwan to tatooine. Padme is for tatooine or pulling Quigon to flip At Last We Will Have Our Revenge.

Once You Flip, you control Marketplace and Watto's Junkyard and Outskirts with 3 chars eacy.. You play A Remote Planet and place Yarua/Tendon at one of them to get a drain of 9 (including obi-wans blade which sould be out by now)plus you retrieve 4.  This will wear them down pretty quick.

Satm/BP is the death of Combat.  with good tracking you can slice maul in control and then drain :-) or in battle and then kill.

This deck can be perfect, but you have to have great tracking because you need to have the right destiny at the right time.
